thread:
alex_k: Quick FYI — PR #5932 (kv-prefetch + microbatch tweaks) is showing a p95 latency bump in the canary for long sequences (1k+ tokens). Can we hold merge until we confirm root cause?

sana_r: saw the alert. pinging bench logs. do we have the exact numbers?

ci-bench-bot: Canary benchmark finished: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/5932/canary-2026-03-16
Summary: baseline -> canary (same infra)
- p50: 12ms -> 14ms
- p95: 24ms -> 46ms  (↑ 22ms)
- p99: 80ms -> 125ms (↑ 45ms)
- memory: 6.1GB -> 6.22GB (↑ 120MB)
Full CSV & flamegraphs in artifacts.

jordan_l: likely culprit is the new prefetch path that touches the allocator a bit earlier — I added additional shm/alloc debug in the branch. I can reproduce a smaller bump locally with longseq-1024 test.

maria_g: can you paste the failing bench command? i'll try to reproduce in lab.

jordan_l: the command I used:
```
./bench --model gptx --seq 1024 --batch 1 --profile --runs 100
```
Local stdout snippet:
```
[run] p95: 48ms
[alloc] peak: +118MB
[notes] extra memcpy in prefetch path
```

alex_k: thanks. @sana_r — any strong opinion on blocking the merge? This PR fixes a correctness edge but has perf impact.

sana_r: prefer hold until we understand. if it's a small regression we can mitigate with rollout (canary -> 10% -> 25%) but since p99 jumped we should be careful. I'll review the diffs tonight and flag specific lines.

maria_g: if jordan can point to the alloc line i'm happy to try an allocator tweak that avoids memcpy.

jordan_l: looks like this block:
```
if (prefetch) {
  // copies key/value into temp buffer
  memcpy(tmp_buf, kv_ptr, len);
}
```
We used memcpy to avoid aliasing, but that adds cost for long seqs. Could use a borrow + refcount trick.

alex_k: action items: jordan to prototype non-copy approach, maria to run lab repro and post flamegraphs, sana to do code perf review. Hold merge for 24h unless someone escalates.

maria_g: reproducing now, uploading flamegraph in ~30m.

ci-bench-bot: Upload complete: flamegraph.svg at https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/5932/flamegraph.svg

oncall-bot: Canary monitor: tail-latency alert still elevated for canary cluster (alert id: canary-180598). Notified oncall.

alex_k: not customer-blocking, so no rollback for now. Please mark the PR as "hold: perf-investigation" and ping here when you have a fix.

jordan_l: will push a prototype branch later today. if it looks good i'll request a fast canary re-run.

sana_r: thanks — i'll prioritize the review tomorrow AM (UTC).

maria_g: flamegraph link: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/5932/flamegraph.svg — hotspot is the memcpy region as expected.

alex_k: perfect. leaving hold and adding a short note to PR description. thx everyone. :thumbsup:
